rules.title: Union Forecast command law
statements: Standard mode offers 3–6 complete contextual Union Forecasts per active Union.
The player selects the Union plan, target, and tactical intent—not each member's exact Art.
Predicted member actions, AP, personal MP, targets, effects, risks, and fallbacks are visible but never clickable.

rules.title: Mixed-role Union behavior
statements: A sword user, axe user, spear user, mage, healer, and tank may all contribute different legal Arts to one complete forecast.
Use Combat Arts is an umbrella intent: each eligible member resolves an Art from their equipped weapon-family tree.
Mixed forecasts may combine weapon Arts, offensive Mystics, healing, support, guarding, provocation, formation, scouting, or objectives.

rules.title: Meaningful-use growth
statements: Character Growth XP advances character level and class-directed stats.
Art discovery and mastery advance only when the relevant Art, tree, weapon family, Mystic school, healing behavior, or defensive behavior has a meaningful effect.
Full-health healing, harmless wards, trivial-enemy farming, menu reopening, and repeated no-effect actions grant no Art progress.
Early deterministic breakthroughs may occur after prerequisites; discovery becomes guaranteed at 100 percent.

rules.title: Fixed weapon-family identity
statements: Every normal Signature Recruit has one fixed native weapon family.
The player may equip any owned weapon within that family and fully controls all normal recruit equipment.
Equipping the matching family makes learned weapon Arts legal; unequipping it preserves mastery but removes those Arts from legal forecast pools.
Exceptional canon or story actors may use separate authority, but Codex may not broaden every recruit to every animation family.

rules.title: Battle and mission rewards
statements: Terminal rewards may include Character Growth XP, Guild Treasury XP, Hall Enhancement XP, Art growth earned during resolution, weapons, armor, offhands, accessories, materials, blueprints, and special found-only relics.
Rewards are committed once from an authoritative seed. Reopening the result screen cannot reroll equipment.
Equipment enters Guild inventory; auto-equip is opt-in, reversible, and respects item and slot locks.

rules.title: City and Guild progression
statements: Character Growth XP, Guild Treasury XP, and Hall Enhancement XP remain separate ledgers.
Guild Treasury XP and materials fund the existing Hall facilities and city improvements.
Facilities improve recruitment, training visibility, crafting, recovery, research, operations, and mastery challenges, but never grant high-tier Arts without meaningful use.

rules.title: Kael canon exception
statements: Kael is not one of the 300 Signature Recruits and is never a normal applicant.
When unlocked through approved story or code authority, Kael is a one-person Union with 300/300 HP, zero normal stats, no weapon, no armor, and no conventional progression.
True Reflection resolves automatically: incoming 30 damage, restore 30 HP, reflect 30 damage. It is not defense, lifesteal, a random counter, or an equipment affix.
